metric_notes.semantic_consistency_check: Implementation consistency between path_labels and verify_path, not real-cloud generalization accuracy.
metric_notes.retrieval_metrics: Computed only on samples with at least one Valid path_label.

dataset_notes: dataset_v1 is a split view of the current semantic corpus, not a new external benchmark.
path-label consistency is a semantic implementation check, not real-cloud generalization accuracy.
SDDP slices remain case-study evidence slices unless explicitly added to a future external_test split.
Main claims should use test and hard_test, not all-corpus development results.
